Purchase of pipes by GAIL
*301. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Gas Authority of India
Limited (GAIL) has invited tenders for
purchase of expensive longitudinally-
welded pipes for laying down its Dahej-
Vijaipur pipeline project;
(b) if so, what are the details in this
regard and whether GAIL is losing more
than Rs. 450 crores on the purchase of these
pipes ignoring the advice of its authorised
Belgium based Engineers Consultant; and
(c) whether Government would probe
the matter and if not, the reasons therefor?
Utilisation of Godavari water
*302. SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA: Will the Minister of
WATER RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Andhra
Pradesh has entered into an agreement with
the Austrian Government for utilisation of
Godavari water in hydel and irrigation
projects;
(b) whether water going waste and
flowing into Bay of Bengal will be utilised
with the implementation of this agreement;
and
(c) by when the work on the proposed
projects is likely to be commenced?
Assistance to Assam from Social
Security Fund
*303. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have released
financial assistance to Assam from Social
Security Fund;
(b) if so, the details of  assistance
released to the State during the last three
years; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Storage capacity of reservoirs
*304. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
WATER RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the storage
capacity of major reservoirs of the country
has come down drastically due to excessive
silting;

Foreign exchange reserves
†*305. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the foreign
exchange reserves of the country has crossed
the $95 billion mark;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
maximum portion thereof happens to be in
dollars; and
(c) if so, what steps Government are
taking in view of the falling prices of dollar
for the last three months as also of the
apprehension of its further decline by about
twenty five per cent in near future and to
avoid financial losses the country is likely
to suffer from?
Transfer of Red Fort to ASI
*306. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Army has
already transferred portions of the Red Fort
to the Archaeological Survey of India;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
complete charge would be handed over to
the Archaeological Survey of India very
soon; and
(c) if so, what steps have been taken by
Government to conserve and restore the
past glory of the Red Fort?
Cauvery River Authority
*307. SHRI M.V. RAJASEKHARAN:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the date on which Cauvery River
Authority was established;
(b) what are the names of members of
this Authority;
(c) the number of times the Authority
has met so far, year-wise; and
(d) what are the main decisions taken
by the Authority?
Modernization of Nagpur Airport
†*308. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether land ownership of Nagpur
Airport is with the Ministry of Defence;
(b) whether modernization and
expansion of the said airport has been
contemplated;
(c) whether any correspondence has
been undertaken with the Ministry of
Defence in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Equity shares against Foreign
Commercial Borrowings
*309. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have allowed
the companies to issue equity shares
against all Foreign Commercial Borrowings;
and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?

Subsidies for Haj
pilgrimage
2163. DR. KARAN SINGH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to continue  to provide subsidies for Haj
pilgrimage  for the 2004 season; if so, with
what  conditions and modifications, vis-a-
vis subsidies provides in 2003; and
(b) whether such subsidies have been
provided for any  other pilgrimages, if so,
the details and to what extent?
Upgradation of airports
in UP
†2164. DR. AKHTAR HASAN RIZVI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of airports  under
National Airports Authority  of India in
Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the number of airports which are
proposed to be upgraded as international
airports  out of them; and
(c) the action taken in this regard so
far?
Study on air tariff
2165. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have mandated
the National Council for Applied Economic
Research to conduct a study and
recommend ways and means to lower air
tariffs;
(b) if so, whether NCAER has  since
submitted its report to Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any other  modalities have
been worked out to lower the air tariffs of
Indian Airlines  and Air India; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Loss incurring routes of IA
2166. SHRI ABHAY KANT
PRASAD: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of loss incurring  routes
being  operated by Indian Airlines at
present;
(b) whether there is a proposal  to allow
private  airlines to operate  on such  routes;

Club at Hyderabad unit
of AAI
2167. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether C&AG in his report No. 3
of 2003  has observed that Hyderabad unit
of the Airports Authority of India granted
license to set up a club at an annual license
fee of Rs. 300 per  Sq. metre although
Headquarters had fixed Rs.1302 per Sq.
metre;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the licensee occupied
7110.5Sq. metre  unauthorisedly and
constructed a restaurant, a marriage hall, a
swimming pool, etc.; and
(d) if so, the action taken in the matter
including the recovery  of damages?
Aircrafts with IA and AI
2168. SHRI EDUARDO FALEIRO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of aircrafts, model name
and year of  acquisition available with both
Air  India and  Indian Airlines;
(b) the details of plans  for acquiring
additional  aircrafts, by both the above
carriers; and
(c) the amount estimated to be spent over
the same plan?
Handing of Dabolim Airport
2169. SHRI EDUARDO FALEIRO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the list of civilian used airports in the
country  which are currently  controlled  by
army, navy or air force authorities;
(b) what is the status of the ownership
of Goa's Dabolim Airport;
(c) whether any representations have
been received for the handing  over of the
airport  to the civilian authorities; and
(d) if so, what action is being taken by
Government in this regard?
Handing  over of Hyderabad Airport
to IAF
2170. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  Government
have decided to hand over Begampet
(Hyderabad Airport) civil airport to IAF for
military flying;
(b) if so, whether  comments from the
Government of Andhra Pradesh have been
sought;
(c) if so, what are the details thereof;
and
(d) whether the handing  over of
Begampet civil airport  to IAF would
hamper the traffic of the proposed
international airport at Shamshabad?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Operation of small  airports
2171. SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR:
SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to allow small airports,
with no-frills to come up in the vicinity of
the international airports, modelled on
London's Stansted Airport,  which would
offer fewer facilities and charge lower rates,
for overall cheaper operations; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the specific sites identified so far for the
purpose in different States?
